mdcw_gw_ui_agreement_available_100000 = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = gw_ui_gw_pair_not_suspended_tt
		not_tooltip = gw_ui_gw_pair_not_suspended_tt_NOT
		mdcw_gw_ui_pair_not_suspended = yes
	}
	hidden_trigger = {
		mdcw_gw_ui_is_receiving_country = yes
		var:ROOT.gw_ui_partner = {
			mdcw_gw_ui_is_sending_country = yes
			NOT = {
				tag = ROOT
			}
		}
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = gw_ui_mdcw_gw_income_gap_tt
		not_tooltip = gw_ui_mdcw_gw_income_gap_tt_NOT
		mdcw_gw_ui_income_advantage = yes
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = gw_ui_mdcw_gw_treasury_tt
		not_tooltip = gw_ui_mdcw_gw_treasury_tt_NOT
		NOT = {
			check_variable = {
				treasury < 25
			}
		}
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = gw_ui_mdcw_gw_receiver_cooldown_tt
		not_tooltip = gw_ui_mdcw_gw_receiver_cooldown_tt_NOT
		NOT = {
			has_country_flag = mdcw_gw_receiving_cooldown
		}
	}
	hidden_trigger = {
		mdcw_gw_ui_has_receiving_state = yes
		var:ROOT.gw_ui_partner = {
			mdcw_gw_ui_has_sending_state_100000 = yes
		}
	}
}

mdcw_gw_ui_has_receiving_state = {
	any_owned_state = {
		is_controlled_by = PREV
	}
}
mdcw_gw_ui_has_sending_state_100000 = {
	any_owned_state = {
		is_controlled_by = PREV
		state_population > 50000
		PREV = {
			any_owned_state = {
				is_controlled_by = PREV
				state_population > 50000
				NOT = {
					state = PREV.PREV
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
mdcw_gw_ui_has_sending_state_25000 = {
	any_owned_state = {
		is_controlled_by = PREV
		state_population > 25000
	}
}

		is_controlled_by = PREV

	}
}
mdcw_gw_ui_income_advantage = {
	set_temp_variable = {
		gw_required_receiver_gdpc = 0
	}
	var:ROOT.gw_ui_partner = {
		ROOT = {
			set_temp_variable = {
				gw_required_receiver_gdpc = PREV.gdp_per_capita
			}
		}
	}
	multiply_temp_variable = {
		gw_required_receiver_gdpc = 1.25
	}
	check_variable = {
		gdp_per_capita > 0
	}
	var:ROOT.gw_ui_partner = {
		check_variable = {
			gdp_per_capita > 0
		}
	}
	NOT = {
		check_variable = {
			gdp_per_capita < gw_required_receiver_gdpc
		}
	}
}
mdcw_gw_ui_is_receiving_country = {
	is_ai = no
	exists = yes
	has_idea = mdcw_ni_guest_worker_recruitment_programme
	NOT = {
		has_country_flag = gw_recruitment_suspended
	}
	NOT = {
		has_country_flag = gw_return_active
	}
}
mdcw_gw_ui_is_sending_country = {
	exists = yes
	has_idea = mdcw_ni_overseas_employment_programme
	NOT = {
		has_country_flag = gw_return_active
	}
}
mdcw_gw_ui_negotiation_free = {
	NOT = {
		has_country_flag = mdcw_gw_request_pending
	}
	NOT = {
		has_country_flag = mdcw_gw_offer_pending
	}
	NOT = {
		has_country_flag = mdcw_gw_offer_window_open
	}
	NOT = {
		has_country_flag = gw_dp_request
	}
	NOT = {
		has_country_flag = gw_dp_offer
	}
	NOT = {
		has_country_flag = gw_dp_offer_window
	}
}
mdcw_gw_ui_pair_not_suspended = {
	var:ROOT.gw_ui_partner = {
		NOT = {
			is_in_array = {
				gw_suspended_hosts = ROOT.id
			}
		}
	}
}
